replacements.old_text: ROO does not introduce a language, compiler, object runtime, or inheritance extension. Version 0.1 is a first edition of the method, a literature map, reusable design worksheets, and a small standard-library-only Rust library. It is intended to grow through worked examples and evidence.
replacements.new_text:
ROO does not introduce a language, compiler, object runtime, or inheritance extension. Version 0.1 is a first edition of the method, a literature map, reusable design worksheets, and a small standard-library-only Rust library. It is intended to grow through worked examples and evidence.

ROO originally stood for Rust Object Oriented. The expansion changed because the method applies beyond Rust; Rust remains the laboratory language.

replacements.old_text: ROO — Rust Object Oriented is a proposed software design method and executable learning laboratory.
replacements.new_text: ROO — Relationship & Ownership Oriented design — is a proposed software design method and executable learning laboratory.
